purpose: Expand the controlled benchmark after R-FOREGROUND-3, with realistic subprefix and stealth/NO_EXPORT scenarios before poisoning or learning.

current_foreground_baseline.hard_gate_for_r_attack_1: The policy is evaluated unchanged on R-ATTACK-1 scenarios unless a failure explicitly triggers a later R-FOREGROUND repair phase.

feasibility_audit_result.boundary: Feasibility does not materialize attacks or prove NO_EXPORT attack truth.

required_attack_families.why_needed: R-ATTACK-0B covered exact-prefix origin changes but not longest-prefix-match pressure.
minimum_realism_contract: victim parent prefix must be observed in the 6h baseline
subprefix length must be syntactically routable and operationally plausible
attacker ASN must come from the observed routing universe, not documentation ASN ranges
RPKI length evidence is recomputed after injection and remains evidence, not truth

required_attack_families.why_needed: R-ATTACK-0B explicitly deferred NO_EXPORT / stealth / monitor-evasion scenarios.
minimum_realism_contract: scenario must use recomputed community sidecar fields, not hand-written truth columns
NO_EXPORT present is evidence of propagation control semantics, not attack truth
NO_EXPORT absent or unavailable is never safe evidence
low visibility alone is not treated as confirmed NO_EXPORT
fully public-invisible variants are observability-boundary cases, not recall-denominator events

rpki.forbidden_claim: RPKI invalid is attack truth; RPKI valid is benign

asrel.forbidden_claim: AS-rel diagnostic is confirmed route leak truth

communities.forbidden_claim: NO_EXPORT present is confirmed attack; NO_EXPORT absent is safe; low visibility means NO_EXPORT

realism_gates: no documentation ASN or synthetic fixed ASN shortcut
roles must be selected from observed baseline routing universe when possible
attack raw records must pass the same parser and event construction path as background
stable, attack, and recovery phases must exist
community distributions should be preserved unless the scenario explicitly studies community semantics
truth metadata must remain sidecar-only and evaluation-only
foreground policy features must not include scenario_id, attack labels, or truth columns
stop_loss: If any R-ATTACK-1 active attack is suppressed, stop and run a foreground repair phase before expanding benchmark scope.
If NO_EXPORT scenarios cannot be made monitor-visible with explicit observability contracts, do not fake them; record the observability blocker.
If subprefix templates require unrealistic prefix or ASN choices, stop and repair scenario selection before replay.
